name: Frostmane Retreat
summary: Frostmane Retreat is an ice troll settlement nestled in the snowy valleys of Dun Morogh between Kharanos and the Tundrid Hills. Established by the Frostmane tribe, it serves as a staging ground and haven for trolls fighting against dwarven encroachment on their ancestral mountain lands.

sections.title: A Bitter Foothold
sections.body: Tucked away in the snowdrifts between Kharanos and the Tundrid Hills, Frostmane Retreat provides the local ice trolls with a fortified camp close to central Dun Morogh. The Frostmane have long inhabited these peaks, and as dwarven settlements expanded outwards from Ironforge, tribal camps like this became essential footholds. From here, troll war parties keep watch on dwarven travel routes, gather supplies, and prepare raids against nearby outposts to push back against Alliance dominance.

sections.title: Perpetual Conflict
sections.body: Because of its proximity to major dwarven supply lines and civilian hubs, the Retreat is viewed as a constant security hazard by Ironforge's military. The Frostmane warriors stationed here are hardy, aggressive, and fiercely protective of their borders. Mountaineers and wayward travelers must tread carefully, as the trolls show no hesitation in slaying any Alliance trespassers who wander into their valley.

faq.answer: Frostmane Retreat is situated in Dun Morogh, tucked into the snowy hills between the town of Kharanos and the Tundrid Hills.
The settlement belongs to the Frostmane tribe, an aggressive faction of ice trolls indigenous to the mountains of Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Why are the Frostmane trolls hostile to travelers?
faq.answer: The Frostmane view the Ironforge dwarves and their Alliance allies as invaders who displaced them from their ancestral mountain territory. As a result, they attack any outsiders on sight.

faq.q: Why is the Retreat a concern for Ironforge?
faq.answer: Its proximity to Kharanos and the major roads across Dun Morogh makes it an ongoing threat to local travelers, merchants, and dwarven patrols moving through the central valley.

angles.text: The presence of a fortified Frostmane village so close to Kharanos is an ongoing challenge to Ironforge's security and mountain sovereignty.
Troll war parties from camps like Frostmane Retreat pose a constant danger to travelers and supply lines winding through Dun Morogh.
